title: Plumbline conformance audit record
description: A §5 evaluator record whose subject is an INSTANCE rather than an artifact. Carries every §5 field, plus audit-specific fields. This is an instance extension under Contracts §8: labelled, recorded, and weakening nothing in §3, §4, or §7. It exists because the audit is itself an evaluator run — if Plumbline's own output were prose, Plumbline would fail the doctrine it enforces.

supersedes.description: The job_id of the record this one supersedes, if any. Corrections and re-audits are NEW records — the superseded record is retained unedited, because a record that can be silently rewritten cannot show whether a finding was fixed, worsened, or reappeared.

revision_reason.description: Required in practice when supersedes is set: what changed and why. Where a revision corrects the AUDIT rather than the instance, say so explicitly — an auditor that quietly patches its own errors is indistinguishable from one that never made them.

artifact_ref.description: What was audited, pinned to an exact revision. MUST carry a value fresh on every run (commit SHA + date) — §7.3 applied to the audit itself, so a re-run is distinguishable from a stale entry.

name.description: The clause id and text, e.g. 'C4 pass rule (average + per-dimension floor)'.

score.description: 10 = clause holds; 5 = clause fails. A fail sits above the reject floor deliberately: a divergence is remediable and opens a new job, it is not a discarded artifact.

anchor_note.description: Why this score, with the specific evidence. Must name which part holds where a clause is partially satisfied.

evidence_ref.description: Path or identifier where the cited evidence lives, so a reader can re-examine it without re-running the audit.

unevidenced_dimensions.description: Clauses not inspected. §5: these force needs_human, never rejected — 'could not be judged' is a different fact from 'judged and found wanting'. Do not synthesise a below-floor score for them.

cap.description: Audits are single-pass: remediation is a NEW audit (a new job), never a re-run of this one, so the record of what was found is never overwritten.

evidence.description: The quoted code, line reference, or observed behaviour. A finding without a specific citation is not a finding.

verdict.description: Exactly the four §5 values. No synonyms.

ground_truth_ref.description: For conformance audits this is the Contracts §9 checklist and its version.

evaluator_identity.description: model + version, and whether the audit was static or executed.

channel_blind_note.description: Where channel_blind is false, say why. A static audit did not observe the instance's runtime evidence channels, so it may not claim §7.2 on the instance's behalf.

method_note.description: How the audit was performed and its limits — static vs executed, revision, what was not inspected.

verdict_derivation.description: The arithmetic that produced the verdict, from the §3 algebra. Makes the verdict checkable rather than asserted.
